name: Thank You Page for WooCommerce – RedFox Thank You
author: RedFox WP

sections.description:
RedFox Thank You is a comprehensive WordPress plugin that gives you power to creates and manages custom “Thank You” and “Order Failed” pages for WooCommerce orders. Transform your default WooCommerce thank you experience into engaging, conversion-focused pages that build trust, encourage repeat purchases, and turn customers into promoters.

🚀 Key Features

Automatic Page Creation
* Creates thank you pages automatically on plugin activation – You can customize it.
* Seamless integration with WooCommerce order flows

Advanced Gutenberg Block System
* 6 specialized blocks for complete customization
* Modern block editor integration
* Responsive design controls for all devices

Secure Order Validation
* Uses order ID and key parameters for security
* Automatic redirect protection for invalid access

Styling Control
* Typography
* Spacing (Padding and Margin)
* Background
* Button styling

🎯 Available Blocks

  1. Customer Details – Complete customer information display
  2. Customer Info – Individual customer data fields
  3. Order Details – Comprehensive order information with product details
  4. Order Info – Individual order data pieces (order number, date, total, etc.)
  5. Downloads – Downloadable products for digital orders
  6. Inline Container – Flexible layout container with flexbox controls

🎯 System Blocks

This two blocks will be used for showing the customized thank you page or order failed page.

  1. Thank You Block – Main thank you page content display
  2. Order Failed – Custom order failure handling and messaging

💡 Perfect For

  • E-commerce stores wanting to improve customer experience
  • Digital product sellers needing download management
  • Service providers requiring custom order instructions
  • Marketing teams looking to increase conversions
  • Developers building custom WooCommerce solutions

🔧 Technical Features

  • Modern Architecture – Built with TypeScript and React
  • Responsive Design – Mobile-first approach with breakpoint controls
  • Performance Optimized – Efficient asset loading and caching
  • Developer Friendly – Extensive hooks and filters for customization
  • WordPress Standards – Follows WordPress coding standards and best practices

🛡️ Security & Access Control

  • Order validation with ID and key verification
  • User permission checks for logged-in customers
  • Guest access support for checkout without accounts
  • Secure parameter sanitization and validation
  • Automatic redirect for invalid access attempts

🔗 WooCommerce Integration

  • Automatic order completion redirect handling
  • Support for all WooCommerce order statuses
  • Digital product download management
  • Payment method and shipping information display
  • Order item details with product images
  • Customer billing and shipping address display

🌐 Multilingual Ready

  • Translation ready with .pot file included
  • RTL (Right-to-Left) language support
  • WPML and Polylang compatible
  • Localized date and currency formatting

📱 Responsive Design

  • Mobile-first responsive design
  • Tablet and desktop optimizations
  • Responsive control system for all styling options
  • Touch-friendly interface elements
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “RedFox Thank You”
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate
  5. The plugin will automatically create thank you and order failed pages

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Upload it to /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  3. Extract the files
  4. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  5. Go to Thank You Pages > Settings to configure settings

After Installation

  1. Visit Thank You Pages to add/edit the thank you page and configure settings
  2. Customize your thank you pages using the Gutenberg block editor
  3. Test with a sample order to ensure everything works correctly
  4. Use the provided blocks to create engaging thank you and order failed pages
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce for this plugin to work?

Yes, this plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated. It integrates directly with WooCommerce’s order processing system.

Will this work with my existing theme?

Yes! The plugin is designed to work with any properly coded WordPress theme. It uses standard WordPress functions and follows theme compatibility best practices.

Can I customize the styling of the thank you pages?

Absolutely! The plugin provides some styling controls including typography, spacing, backgrounds, and responsive design options.

Does it work with guest checkout?

Yes, the plugin fully supports guest checkout. It uses order keys for validation, allowing customers to access their thank you page even without a user account.

Is the plugin translation ready?

Yes, the plugin is fully translation ready with included .pot files and supports RTL languages. It’s also compatible with WPML and Polylang.

Does it affect site performance?

No, the plugin is optimized for performance with efficient asset loading, code splitting, and conditional script loading. It only loads necessary resources when needed.

Can I use it with page builders?

The plugin uses Gutenberg blocks, which are compatible with the WordPress block editor. For other page builders, you may need to use custom integration.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

The thank you pages will remain, but the custom functionality will be disabled. You can choose to delete plugin data during uninstallation in the settings.
